nodes.label: GOAL: raise Gary's profile
nodes.desc: The first goal at the centre of everything: to be known as a practical AI person in performance marketing. Search visibility, articles, posts and outreach all feed it.

nodes.label: GOAL: financial growth
nodes.desc: The second goal: long-term financial growth and stability for Gary's family. Career moves and the trading system (which has to prove itself on practice money first) feed it.

nodes.label: Gary (decides)
nodes.desc: Gary himself. He only sees what genuinely needs a human decision: drafts to approve, changes to the site and anything that touches trading. Everything else the teams handle on their own.

nodes.label: Wade (local AI)
nodes.desc: Gary's local AI model, running on his home PC through LM Studio. Wade drafts articles, runs the website departments and the Supervisor, and scores work for the other teams. A queue makes jobs take turns so he never overloads.

nodes.label: Data pull
nodes.desc: Pulls search, analytics and behaviour data for the website every day, so every other agent works from real numbers. If the PC was off, the Catch-Up restarts it.

nodes.label: Industry Watch
nodes.desc: Reads AI, search and marketing news so the Content Engine knows what is happening this week.

nodes.label: Listening Post
nodes.desc: Reads around 18 news feeds each week, has Wade summarise the best stories, and builds the public News roundup every two weeks.

nodes.label: Content Engine
nodes.desc: Decides what to write next, one job an hour: Gary's own requests first, then his ideas, his best LinkedIn posts, target search terms and the news.

nodes.label: Content Writer
nodes.desc: Wade drafting an article from Gary's own facts, notes and feedback, kept inside a size budget so nothing gets cut off.

nodes.label: Truth check
nodes.desc: Reads every finished draft against its sources and blocks anything invented about Gary. One rewrite is allowed; after that the topic goes to a person.

nodes.label: Notebook (notes)
nodes.desc: The team's own labelled notes, such as lessons from past mistakes. Agents pull only the notes they need, and the notes are condensed when they grow too long.

nodes.label: Weekly Review
nodes.desc: The weekly website review. A triage step decides which departments to call, they run, and then the Supervisor and Manager take over. It re-runs itself if a step fails.

nodes.label: 6 SEO departments
nodes.desc: Six specialist departments: SEO, content, AI visibility, user experience, page speed and technical SEO. An issue has to be seen twice before it counts.

nodes.label: Website Supervisor
nodes.desc: Turns what the departments find into root-caused fixes. Rules in code drop anything already handled, merge repeats into one 'stuck' card and file every card in the right place.

nodes.label: Website Manager
nodes.desc: Builds the short list of what needs Gary's decision, leaving out anything already handled.

nodes.label: Internal dashboard (website)
nodes.desc: An internal dashboard where Gary makes the website decisions. Its details are kept private.

nodes.label: Website Executor
nodes.desc: Turns an approved YES into a real change on its own branch, then merges it only after the layout and SEO checks pass.

nodes.label: Article queue
nodes.desc: Releases approved articles at a steady pace, two a week and at least three days apart, never on the same day as a guide.

nodes.label: Guide queue
nodes.desc: Releases approved guides at a steady pace.

nodes.label: Image Briefs
nodes.desc: Writes image prompts in Gary's house style for any article that needs a picture.

nodes.label: Image Inbox
nodes.desc: Watches for Gary's finished images, puts the right one on the right article and takes it live.

nodes.label: SEO Auto-Fixer
nodes.desc: Fixes basic SEO by itself with no approval needed: page titles, descriptions, image alt text and related links.

nodes.label: Goal Strategist
nodes.desc: Works back from Gary's goal search terms, fixes plain faults daily and judges the bigger strategy every 90 days.

nodes.label: Standards Watch
nodes.desc: Watches Google's and Bing's rule pages for changes, and makes sure every change gets a decision.

nodes.label: Shipped Closer
nodes.desc: Closes recommendations whose work has already gone live, so nothing is asked twice.

nodes.label: Results Tracker
nodes.desc: Judges each shipped change on its own measure, such as page speed for a speed fix, after 28 and 90 days.

nodes.label: Rubric Calibration
nodes.desc: Checks whether the quality score actually predicts what Gary approves, and learns from every decision he makes.

nodes.label: Indexing Chaser
nodes.desc: Checks which pages Google and Bing have found, and tells Bing the moment a page changes.

nodes.label: System Auditor
nodes.desc: Checks every automation is running, producing real output and connected, and says why when one is not.

nodes.label: Catch-Up
nodes.desc: Runs every 30 minutes: restarts anything that was missed while the PC was off, wakes Wade, releases queued articles and runs the check behind this map.

nodes.label: Website Task Health
nodes.desc: Reads the result of every website scheduled task and explains any failure in plain English.

nodes.label: Village Publish
nodes.desc: Publishes the public Village every evening, and this map with it.

nodes.label: Kids Games go-live
nodes.desc: Publishes the Kids Games pages.

nodes.label: Syndication (dev.to)
nodes.desc: Shares finished technical articles on dev.to with a link back to the original, one at a time.

nodes.label: Website repo sync
nodes.desc: Keeps Gary's local copy of the website in step with the live version.

nodes.label: garystow.co.uk (live)
nodes.desc: This website: articles, guides, news, tools and games. Almost every website agent ends up here.

nodes.label: Observatory
nodes.desc: A private agent. It stays on the map so you can see it is connected, but what it does is kept private.

nodes.label: Outreach team
nodes.desc: A private agent. It stays on the map so you can see it is connected, but what it does is kept private.

nodes.label: Trading runs (GitHub)
nodes.desc: The trading system's scheduled runs: scanning the market and placing practice orders for each strategy on a timetable.

nodes.label: Analyst
nodes.desc: Reads every trading signal every 30 minutes and flags anything odd in the data.

nodes.label: Recommender
nodes.desc: Turns the Analyst's confirmed findings into proposals for the Supervisor.

nodes.label: Fill Analyst
nodes.desc: Measures how many orders actually fill, and works out why the others do not.

nodes.label: Game Activity Monitor
nodes.desc: Checks that the premarket strategy traded in its window, or explains why it did not.

nodes.label: Game Freshness Watchdog
nodes.desc: Makes sure the premarket strategy's list of shares is fresh before the market opens.

nodes.label: No-Trade Watchdog
nodes.desc: Tells a strategy that is quiet on purpose apart from one that is broken.

nodes.label: Performance Watch
nodes.desc: Tracks each strategy's results against its goals.

nodes.label: Premarket Shadow
nodes.desc: Tests premarket ideas in shadow, with no orders placed.

nodes.label: Box Shadow
nodes.desc: Tests another strategy idea in shadow, with no orders placed.

nodes.label: Data Coverage
nodes.desc: Checks every price-data feed is still updating and fills any gaps in the history.

nodes.label: Reddit Ticker Watch
nodes.desc: Watches Reddit for shares that are suddenly getting attention.

nodes.label: Research Lab
nodes.desc: Runs strategy experiments every week. Anything it finds goes to Gary as a proposal, never straight into the trading code.

nodes.label: Ignore List Review
nodes.desc: Reviews shares the broker will not trade, so they are skipped before an order is even tried.

nodes.label: Trading Supervisor
nodes.desc: Root-causes everything the trading departments raise and deals with the noise itself.

nodes.label: Trading Manager
nodes.desc: Builds Gary's trading decision list and goal status, counting every decision that is waiting.

nodes.label: Internal dashboard (trading)
nodes.desc: An internal dashboard where Gary makes the trading decisions. Its details are kept private.

nodes.label: Decision Processor
nodes.desc: Records Gary's YES and NO decisions so the Executor knows what it is allowed to do.

nodes.label: Trading Executor
nodes.desc: Does approved trading work on its own branch, never directly on the live code.

nodes.label: Goals Dispatcher
nodes.desc: Sends the trading goals to the Executor to investigate.

nodes.label: Team Performance
nodes.desc: Measures how often the team's own proposals turn out to be right, so the team improves its own process.

nodes.label: Task Health Watchdog
nodes.desc: Checks every scheduled task across the whole system and explains any failure.

nodes.label: Go-Live Scorecard
nodes.desc: Decides whether a strategy is ready for real money: clean days, shadow results and practice profit after costs.

nodes.label: Wade Repo Auto Pull
nodes.desc: Keeps the trading code on Gary's PC up to date every 30 minutes.

edges.what: articles go live with their image
